picks.name: Clark
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Throttle Records. Clark featured on Bicep's "Air / Lemonder / Viper" (Sept 25) -- already adjacent to your library through that collaboration.
picks.bio: "Steep Stims II" (October 23, 2026, Throttle Records) gathers Clark's Modal, Opponent and Entity Stims EPs alongside the previously unreleased track "Naiveventide" -- a sequel compilation to 2025's Access Virus-constrained "Steep Stims."
picks.why_listen: Hooky, hardware-synth-driven dancefloor material from a veteran IDM/techno producer -- functional and texturally distinct from most of your current rotation.
